I took my 7-year-old Pomeranian to this facility for pre-trip checkups, and we were also offered a teeth cleaning. After the procedure, performed under anesthesia, she had serious complications and unfortunately did not survive. We later discovered discrepancies in the consent documentation. We are pursuing the matter legally. It was a painful experience that has deeply affected us.

I went to this veterinary clinic under the name of Antonia Maria Vejerano to have my Pomeranian undergo some blood tests in preparation for a trip. During the visit, I was also advised to undergo a tartar cleaning under anesthesia. After the procedure, my Pomeranian (Vanilla) suffered serious complications that led to her death. After analyzing the situation, I discovered that the informed consent signature did not belong to my mother, but was forged.

We have initiated the necessary legal action to resolve this matter and are seeking redress for the damages suffered. The clinic has not responded to our formal communications nor has it responded, despite the serious mistake made and the irreparable damage suffered by our animal.

I am deeply disappointed by the clinic's lack of transparency and complete lack of accountability. I absolutely do not recommend this place for animal health and well-being.

I came to this clinic for the first time on the recommendation of two friends to have my kitten, Macchia, examined, after he had suddenly developed a drooling fit.
Dr. Carcano cared for my beloved kitten with extreme professionalism and compassion, meticulously explaining the cause of his problem, which was promptly resolved.
In short, I absolutely recommend this facility to anyone looking for serious, reliable, and empathetic professionals to whom they can entrust the care of their four-legged friends.
